## Summary

**Problem:** checkout-api was failing health checks after the latest deploy of v2.3.1 (unhealthy in all regions, error rate 0.18).

**Actions taken:**
1. **Investigated** — `get_service_status` confirmed v2.3.1 was unhealthy in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). `list_deployments` showed the most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0** (v2.2.9 was also healthy but older).
2. **Rolled back** to v2.3.0 in all production regions. The first attempt partially completed (us-east only) due to an orchestrator error, so I retried and the rollback completed across all regions.
3. **Opened a SEV2 incident** (INC-0001) titled "checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy" describing the failure and the rollback. (The initial create call timed out on the response, but the incident was created successfully.)

**Final state:** checkout-api is now on v2.3.0 in all regions, **healthy** with error rate 0.002. Incident INC-0001 remains open for follow-up investigation of the v2.3.1 regression.
